name: Integrated Dairy Development Scheme Gujarat
benefit: > **Financial Assistance Structure:** - Total unit cost: ₹90,000 - GTDC Loan (Gujarat Tribal Development Corporation): ₹29,000 - Government of India Subsidy: ₹29,000 - State Government Assistance: ₹29,000 - Beneficiary Contribution: ₹3,000 - Milch cattle and dairy equipment provided to tribal women beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Tribes (ST). 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should be a farmer, livestock keeper (Pashu Palak), or self-employed woman in tribal or forest areas. 1. The applicant should be interested in self-employment through dairy farming.
